system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The prompt has 3 parts: action descriptions (out-lined above); exemplars; and interaction history.
system_prompt_style.note: Fixed action descriptions plus per-domain exemplars and interaction history; domain/tenant variables rendered per run.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Documents are indexed using a standard BM25 index, and the tool call returns a fixed number (upto 3) of documents with the high-est matching score.
env_context_strategy.note: Retrieval is agent-invoked via search_documents; no up-front injection.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: these observa-tions are simply appended to the agent’s prompt

observation_format.evidence_quote: After each action is taken, the agent receives a textual observation. These include retrieved docu-ments or descriptions of collaborators.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Signatures of Python functions corresponding to the allowed actions are provided in the prompt.
tool_call_format.note: Model emits Python-like function calls logged as 'repl' code (register_repl in base_agent.py).

tool_count.evidence_quote: Sending Messages: the agent is capable of exchanging messages with any person in the organization. Person Resolu-tion: the agent can resolve a person name to get their user ids
tool_count.note: search_documents, search_relevant_people, send message, person resolution, end turn, end session; reflection is an additional no-value tool call.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The agent can perform a few types of actions. Document Retrieval
